title: Nscale Says Microsoft Has Withdrawn From UK Data Center Deal
summary: Microsoft Corp. has pulled out of a UK data center deal with Nscale, the British neocloud firm said, marking a setback for the startup’s initial public offering hopes.

title: OpenAI Arrest Raises AI Espionage Concerns
summary: Morgan Meaker, a senior writer for Bloomberg Weekend, tells Bloomberg This Weekend about the arrest of an OpenAI engineer accused of planting a covert recording device in an executive conference room, a case highlighting growing concerns about protecting sensitive AI technology. Meaker also explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini how AI training work is shifting toward highly skilled experts and why that evolution could eventually reshape the professions providing that expertise. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Short of Time and Influence, Macron Fights to Remain Relevant
summary: Emmanuel Macron still has plenty of ideas, but in the home stretch of his presidency he’s lost much of the power to turn them into reality.

title: Woodside Pauses Scarborough Pre-Commissioning Due to Protest
summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd. said that pre-commissioning work at its Scarborough project off the coast of Western Australia was paused after Greenpeace protesters climbed aboard the gas platform.

title: PBOC Deputy Urges Private Role in Sovereign Debt Restructuring
summary: China’s deputy central bank governor Xuan Changneng called for greater private-sector participation in sovereign debt restructuring as rising borrowing costs add to developing countries’ debt-servicing burdens.

title: Zelenskyy Says Starlink Speed Restrictions Look Deliberate
summary: Restrictions on Ukraine’s military use of SpaceX’s Starlink system appear to be deliberate and not the result of any technical problems, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, while denouncing a US decision to waive sanctions against Russia.

title: AI Trade Reversal Pierces Asia’s Star Picks-and-Shovels Stocks
summary: A deepening selloff in US technology stocks is exposing a new vulnerability in Asia’s artificial intelligence trade: mounting financing costs could choke off the spending needed to sustain the boom, threatening earnings across a supply chain that has powered the region’s stock-market rally.
